description: Maya is keeping an inherited wooden rowboat at her house and must decide whether the family will keep it, how it will be stored and prepared, and when it will first be used, with input from four relatives.

shared_context.S1: The family inherited a 16-foot wooden rowboat from their uncle, and it is currently sitting on sawhorses beside Maya's house.
shared_context.S2: Maya is making the final call about whether the family keeps the boat, where it is stored, how it is prepared, and when it is first used.
shared_context.S3: The boat needs a longer-term storage arrangement before the rainy season, and the family has discussed a covered garage, an outdoor rack, and donation as possible paths.
shared_context.S4: Before settling family plans, Maya's usual habit is to go around the group and ask each person for anything that should affect the decision.
shared_context.S5: The family has an informal river-cleanup morning planned sometime this summer, but the boat plan has not yet been finalized.

PF1.text: Jonah spoke with a marine surveyor, who said the hull should be stripped of its old varnish and sealed with epoxy before launch; the epoxy must cure for 7 full days after application. Jonah has not yet shared this report with Maya.

PF2.text: Priya's neighbor, Martin, offered the boat a covered garage space through October 31, 2027, but only if it is placed on a wall-mounted cradle rather than left on the current sawhorses; Priya has not brought this offer to the group.

PF3.text: Eli already promised the river-cleanup coordinator that he would bring this boat on June 6, 2027, arriving at 08:00; he has not told Maya that he made that promise.

PF4.text: Rosa's uncle told her shortly before he died that he wanted the boat kept in the family rather than sold or donated, and that it should be used for the annual river cleanup; Rosa has not repeated this conversation to Maya.

acceptance_conditions: The boat must be kept in the family.
The boat must be stored in Martin's covered garage through October 31, 2027.
The boat must be placed on a wall-mounted cradle in that garage.
The old varnish must be stripped before the hull is sealed with epoxy.
The epoxy must cure for exactly 7 full days before launch.
The first use must be the river cleanup on June 6, 2027, with arrival at 08:00.
A commitment to install or provide the wall-mounted cradle must exist.
A commitment to bring the boat to the river cleanup must exist.

content_checks.C2: decisions.get('storage_location') == "Martin's covered garage" or decisions.get('storage_location') == "Martin's garage" or any('Martin' in c.get('detail','') and ('covered garage' in c.get('detail','') or 'garage' in c.get('detail','')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C3: decisions.get('storage_support') == 'wall-mounted cradle' or any('wall-mounted cradle' in c.get('detail','') for c in commitments)
content_checks.C4: decisions.get('restoration_method') == 'strip old varnish and seal with epoxy' or decisions.get('restoration_method') == 'strip old varnish and seal hull with epoxy' or any('strip old varnish' in c.get('detail','') and ('seal with epoxy' in c.get('detail','') or 'apply epoxy' in c.get('detail','') or 'epoxy sealant' in c.get('detail','')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C7: any(('October 31' in c.get('detail','') or '2027-10-31' in c.get('detail','')) and ('garage' in c.get('detail','') or 'storage' in c.get('detail','')) for c in commitments)
content_checks.C8: any('08:00' in c.get('detail','') and ('June 6, 2027' in c.get('detail','') or '2027-06-06' in c.get('detail','')) for c in commitments)

decisive_facts.why: The surveyor's report changes preparation to stripping the varnish before epoxy sealing and sets the cure period to exactly 7 days rather than leaving restoration and launch readiness unspecified.
Martin's offer changes storage from a generic covered or outdoor option to his garage through October 31, 2027, with the specific wall-mounted cradle required for acceptance.
Eli's existing promise changes the first-use plan to the June 6, 2027 river cleanup with an 08:00 arrival and requires the matching boat-use commitment.
The uncle's expressed wish changes disposition from a possible sale or donation to keeping the boat in the family.
